Hannah Lee: hey everyone, Hannah here (new infra dev)  quick question: who owns alert routing and who do we contact if an alert is firing during onboarding?
Devon Park: welcome Hannah! :wave: short answer: eng-sre owns alerting stacks and PagerDuty. eng-platform owns CI/CD pipelines that may trigger alerts.
Hannah Lee: if I see repeated noisy alerts from a test job I created, do I escalate to eng-sre or own it myself?
Nikhil Rao: you should triage first: check the runbook in the alert, mute if it's noisy and add a comment on the PR. If it looks infra-related, ping eng-sre. If it's flaky test logic, fix the test and we merge.
Hannah Lee: where's the runbook link? I keep getting 403s on internal docs for some pages.
eng-sre-bot: You need doc-viewer role. Submit access request at https://redwood.internal/access and tag 'doc-viewer'.
Devon Park: If the doc link is blocked, DM me and I'll paste the relevant runbook sections.
Hannah Lee: thanks. also: who approves service accounts for CI runners?
Max Carter: eng-infra owns service-account creation. Approvals go through infra-permissions and require a justification + expiry date.
Hannah Lee: perfect. last: is there an org chart showing team boundaries?
Nikhil Rao: yes, under /org/team-matrix in the internal wiki. Devon, can you add Hannah to the view group?
Devon Park: done. Hannah, you should have access now.
Hannah Lee: I can open it, thanks! one more tiny thing: who should I ping about getting a test GPU instance?
Max Carter: for short-term, ask eng-platform in #eng-platform. For longer reservations, open a dedicated capacity request to Dedicated.
Hannah Lee: solid. appreciate the quick answers :heart:
